org.xces.graf.uima
Class TypeSystemFactory

java.lang.Object
  org.xces.graf.uima.TypeSystemFactory

public class TypeSystemFactory
extends Object

The TypeSystemFactory can be used to generate a UIMA type system from a graph. The names of the types created depends on the annotation set and annotation names used in the graph and is controlled by a pair of ILabelMaker objects.

The type system factory also creates the FsIndexDescription array as it generates the type system. After a type system has been generated the index array can retrieved with a call to getIndices().
